name: AI-enabled borescope training
summary: Reported by MRO Business Today on October 14. AEMTC, based at the Civil Aviation Flight University of China, has trained about 17,500 technical professionals from more than 120 airlines, MROs and manufacturers. It is adding AI-enabled borescope training and mixed-reality instruction to prepare technicians for LEAP engine work, while keeping human judgment at the center of inspection and maintenance decisions. Plans also include adding GE90 and GE9X engines to its training.

whyItMatters: A new hire who can read a borescope image confidently is billable sooner. If your shop competes for engine work, ask your training providers whether their borescope courses include AI-assisted practice, since that is the tool your technicians will likely use on the job.
